ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Name the stage represented by B.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of the butterfly life cycle, with multiple stages labeled by letters. The letter B is located at the upper right, and beside it is drawn a relatively large striped caterpillar on a green leaf. Reasoning: In the butterfly life cycle, the caterpillar is the larval stage; after hatching from the egg, it continuously eats leaves and grows, and only afterward becomes a pupa. The caterpillar shown by B is already relatively large and fully developed, so it represents the fully grown caterpillar stage.
